Try a robust trimmed mean to mitigate ranking instability and high trend/seasonality.
test a robust weighted combination using inverse_error to counter unstable ranking and high trend/seasonality.
test a different kind of robust weighted combination on the full pool to see if including all models improves over pool4.
Try a robust weighted combination using softmax_neg_error on the full pool to see if it improves over inverse_error, given high trend/seasonality and unstable ranking.
I want to test a per‑horizon weighted strategy that uses the best model at each step, since ranking is unstable and models may excel at different horizons.
test a forward-selection weighted combination on the full pool to see if greedy selection improves over the robust inverse-error weighting, given the unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality.
test robust median on all models
The series shows unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality, so a simple robust mean over a stable subset (pool4) might perform well and differs from previous weighted combos.
test per-horizon softmax weighting on pool5

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9735. Series context: trend strength 0.9863 and seasonal strength 0.7128; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.064); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.641.
